searxng.description: Private web search and page reader on a NetBird overlay (no key). searxng_web_search: required `query`; knobs `categories` (it|news|science|packages|general), `time_range` (day|week|month|year), `num_results` (1-20), `pageno`, `min_score` (0-1), `language`, `safesearch`; returns title + snippet + URL + relevance, no answer text. web_url_read: `url` -> clean markdown, with `maxLength`/`startChar`/`section`/`paragraphRange`/`readHeadings`; no JavaScript, rejects PDF and binary. Unreliable upstream engines surface as `unresponsive_engines`-style gaps, not errors: retry with `categories=it` or rephrase rather than assuming downtime.
